full_judgment: 33. On a plain reading of clause 8 of the allotment নীতিমালা, ২০০৪, it appears that it does not put any limitation or restriction for qualifying the affected person on the quantum of land acquired. As such, as per নীতিমালা anybody would be considered an affected person from whom some land has been acquired for the improvement scheme.
